query:
UPDATE shipments SET status = $2,
             shipped_at = CASE WHEN $2 = 'shipped' THEN coalesce(shipped_at, now()) ELSE shipped_at END,
             delivered_at = CASE WHEN $2 = 'delivered' THEN coalesce(delivered_at, now())
                                 ELSE delivered_at END,
             updated_at = now()
         WHERE id = $1
